message.content:
An editorial illustration for "TEMPO" magazine shows two people in a setting resembling a supermarket aisle with blurred shelves. On the right, a large man with dark hair and a light-colored tunic and trousers carries a precarious stack of seven brown cardboard boxes. He leans back, one foot raised, seemingly struggling with the weight. The boxes feature various logos, including a red-and-green circular crest and the text "Danantara Indonesia". One box displays a line drawing of a compartmentalized food tray. To the left, a woman with dark hair, glasses, and a brown dress stands holding a red plastic shopping basket. She looks toward the man with an open-mouthed expression and raised hands.

Large red text "TEMPO" dominates the top. Smaller black text includes the headlines "TERMEHEK-MEHEK UTANG", "Pelanggaran Wakil Menteri Jadi Komisaris BUMN H.28", and "Rumah Mangkrak Prajurit TNI AD H.90". A vertical barcode and "4-10 AGUSTUS 2025" are visible on the bottom left. The background consists of geometric lines suggests a ceiling and tiled floor.
